title: Bounded flat model from a lifting class
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a commutative ring, and $C=\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\operatorname{ModuleCat}(\Lambda))$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site; def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], with its usual tensor product. Write $D(C)$ and $Q$ for its derived category and localization functor [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with K-flat derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. Call $F\in C$ flat when $F\otimes-$ is exact. Let $S,T$ be properties of objects of $C$. Suppose $T$ contains zero and is closed under isomorphisms, kernels and cokernels of maps between its objects. Suppose $S$ contains zero, is closed under isomorphisms and binary biproducts, and every $S$-object is flat and belongs to $T$. Suppose also that $S$ lifts epimorphisms onto $T$: for every epimorphism $p:A\to B$ and map $g:G\to B$ with $T(G)$ there exist $E$ with $S(E)$, an epimorphism $e:E\to G$, and $h:E\to A$ such that $p\circ h=g\circ e$. For integers $a,b$ and $K\in D(C)$ such that every $H^n(K)$ belongs to $T$ and $H^i(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}F[0])=0$ for every $F\in C$ and every $i<a$ or $i>b$, there is a cochain complex $P$ with $P^n=0$ outside $[a,b]$, every $P^n$ flat and in $T$, and $Q(P)\cong K$.
